The Mg2Ti4O8 structure crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies octahedral Ti centers coordinated by six O neighbors, and tetrahedral O centers coordinated by four Mg/Ti neighbors, with Mg environments of two O neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows corner- and edge-sharing between Ti octahedra and corner-sharing between Ti octahedra and O tetrahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites.
